title: Cherrypicking Protocol for Automated Liquid Handling
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs cherrypicking from x source plates to y destination plates, both Bio-Rad 96-well low profile PCR plates (200µl). The user can specify the sources and destinations in any slot, and the protocol will automatically load the plate in that slot. Tipracks will automatically be loaded in the remaining available slots. In the case that all tips are exhausted, the protocol pauses, and the user is prompted to refill the racks before resuming. The CSV should be formatted like so: ``` source slot, source well, destination slot, destination well, volume 1,A1,3,A1,5 ... ``` **The header line should be included (the first line from the .csv file is ignored)** --- * [Bio-Rad 96-well low profile PCR plates (200µl)](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Opentrons P50-single electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 300µl tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips)
Upload CSV and input your protocol parameters.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect Bio‑Rad 96‑well low‑profile PCR plates (200 µL capacity), an Opentrons P50‑single electronic pipette, and Opentrons 300 µL tipracks.

steps.title: Prepare CSV and load plates
steps.instruction: Create a cherrypicking CSV file with a header line (the first line will be ignored) and rows formatted as: source slot, source well, destination slot, destination well, volume. Example row: 1,A1,3,A1,5. Load the source and destination plates (Bio‑Rad 96‑well low‑profile PCR plates) into any deck slots; tipracks will automatically occupy the remaining slots. If all tips are used, the protocol will pause and prompt you to refill the tipracks before continuing.

substeps.instruction: Create the CSV file using the specified column order and include the header line.
Place the source and destination plates on the deck in any available slots.
Ensure tipracks are loaded in the remaining slots; be prepared to replace them if the protocol pauses for tip refill.

steps.title: Upload CSV and set parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, upload the prepared CSV file and enter any required protocol parameters.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol script from the app.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol script into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing plates and tipracks in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of the labware, tipracks, and the P50‑single electronic pipette (refer to the app’s calibration tips if needed).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated cherrypicking procedure.
